name: MOT17
description: A benchmark dataset for multi-object tracking in crowded scenes, providing video sequences with pedestrian detections and tracking annotations. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Milan, A., Leal-Taixé, L., Reid, I., Roth, S., & Schindler, K. (2016). MOT16: A Benchmark for Multi-Object Tracking. arXiv:1603.00831. https://arxiv.org/abs/1603.00831
